property_summary: For all valid inputs, the transfer function returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function does not revert when called with non-empty _tos array.
The transfer function does not revert when called with a non-empty _tos array and a valid from address.
transfer reverts when called with a non-empty _tos array and a zero-length from address.
For any call to transfer with non-empty _tos array and a caddress that is a contract implementing transferFrom, the function does not revert.
The function transfer should revert if any token transfer from the call fails.
The return value of transfer should be true if and only if all external calls succeed (i.e., the function does not revert).
The balance of the contract should not increase after a successful transfer call that reverts on any failed subcall.

After transfer() completes, all recipients should be able to transferFrom the original sender for the exact amount, but the buggy version fails to revert on failed transfers and thus leaves some recipients without the token.
After a call to transfer succeeds, the caller can transfer the specified amount from all recipients back to the original sender.
The transfer function should not revert for any valid input where _tos is non-empty.
The transfer function should revert whenever caddress.call reverts, which occurs when caddress is the zero address (or does not implement transferFrom).
After a successful call to transfer where the first recipient is a non-zero address, the return value should be true.
Calling transfer with a non-zero length _tos array should not revert when caddress is the zero address (since the call to the zero address succeeds without reverting).
When caddress is not the zero address and has no code, calling transfer should succeed (not revert) because the call will return success with empty return data.
The transfer function should complete without reverting when the external call succeeds.
The transfer function should return true when the external call succeeds and no revert is inserted before return.
The transfer function should not revert when at least one recipient address is provided and all external calls succeed.
